a1.say: Let's solve Longest Shared Subsequence, using the 2D DP With Rolling Rows approach.

a1.cap: Return the length of the longest subsequence that appears in both strings a and b.

lines: Return the length of the longest subsequence that appears in both strings a and b.

a1.cap: For example, with a = "abcde", b = "ace", the answer is 3. "ace".
a1.say: For example, with a equals "abcde", b equals "ace", the answer is 3. "ace".

a1.cap: dp[i][j] is the answer for the first i letters of a and first j of b. Matching letters add one to the diagonal value; otherwise take the better of dropping a letter from either string.
a1.say: dp at i, j is the answer for the first i letters of a and first j of b. Matching letters add one to the diagonal value; otherwise take the better of dropping a letter from either string.

a1.cap: Each row only needs the row above, so two rows suffice.
